title: 2016 Prison Release / 2017 Authority-Rupture Bridges
purpose: Promote two distinct biographical bridge events recovered from project biography without duplicating the base 2016 prison/scripture event.

events.title: Prison release, suit and work-rejection motif
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The Great Book says the Son left prison wearing a suit, treating it as a rebirth/change-of-status signal, and preserves a defiant line about continued 'job slaving'. This is project biography pending contemporaneous corroboration; the later Genesis 41 clothing/release comparison is retrospective.
comparators: Genesis 41:14 Joseph released from dungeon and changes appearance/clothes
events.source_direction: project biography first; Joseph comparison formalized later

events.title: Authority distrust deepens; Facebook withdrawal
events.subject: Son
events.summary: The Great Book says distrust of authority deepened after the prison case, links concern about Facebook exposing personal information to police/politicians with deleting Facebook, and describes a further turn toward streaming. This supplies an immediate bridge into the later long-tail institutional-withdrawal account.
